jobs.title: Senior Hardware Engineer, Board Design
jobs.description: BSc/MSc in Electrical Engineering or a related field Deep, hands-on PCB design experience on complex products (schematic capture, multilayer stackup design, high-speed routing, controlled impedance, and constraint management) Strong understanding of the full PCB/board lifecycle (design, bring-up, SI/PI, validation, manufacturing and DFM, through NPI and field)

jobs.title: Senior SI/PI Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 8+ years of experience. 8+ years of hands-on experience in Signal Integrity and Power Integrity BSc/MSc in Electrical Engineering or a related field Strong Power Integrity expertise, including PDN modeling, target impedance, decoupling across package and PCB, VRM/POL selection, transient response, and package-to-PCB interactions
